shard.name: NeoForge
shard.description: The community-driven modding platform for Minecraft, carrying forward the legacy of Forge with modern tooling.
shard.author: NeoForged & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# NeoForge Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq openjdk21-jre-headless

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" ] || [ "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest NeoForge version..."
    NEOFORGE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://maven.neoforged.net/api/maven/versions/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge | jq -r '.versions[-1]')
fi

echo "Target NeoForge version: ${NEOFORGE_VERSION}"
INSTALLER_URL="https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar"

echo "Downloading NeoForge installer from ${INSTALLER_URL}..."
curl -o installer.jar -fSL "${INSTALLER_URL}"

echo "Running NeoForge server installation..."
java -jar installer.jar --installServer
rm -f installer.jar

if [ -f "run.sh" ]; then
    chmod +x run.sh
fi

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "NeoForge installation completed!"
